units.divergence: nats (natural logarithm); JS(d, q) with half weights lies in [0, log 2]
units.env_steps: environment transitions (one call of the simulator kernel per trajectory and time step)
units.return: discounted sum sum_{t<H} gamma^t r_g(s_{t+1}) (next-state timing), gamma and H from configs/environment.yaml
units.time: seconds (s); wall-clock, with torch.cuda.synchronize() before each reading on CUDA
units.updates: optimizer steps (f-PG policy updates, FB minibatch updates, DM latent steps)
